findings: Missing RolesGuard on artist mutations — PATCH /:id, POST /:id/cover, POST /:id/finalize, POST /:id/credits, and POST /:id/submit use only JwtAuthGuard. Add RolesGuard and @Roles(UserRole.ARTIST) to each to match the design contract and prevent non-ARTISTs from reaching assertOwnsTrack.

Stale coverImageUrl in FeedService and ArtistsService — Both services' inline mapTrack return raw R2 keys for coverImageUrl instead of presigned URLs. Inject StorageService into both and call resolveCoverUrl, or extract the shared TrackMapper the design doc planned.

Upload page step 5 does not poll — useTrack(trackId) is called without refetchInterval, so the PROCESSING spinner never resolves automatically. Additionally, useTrack calls GET /tracks/:id which only returns PUBLISHED tracks, so a DRAFT track always 404s when polled from the upload page.
Cover upload endpoint missing role guard — POST /:id/cover accepts any authenticated user (multipart file upload path). Add @Roles(UserRole.ARTIST) with RolesGuard.

Presigned PUT MIME enforcement is advisory only — head.contentType at finalize is not validated against AUDIO_MIME_TYPES before enqueueing the job or storing on MediaAsset. Add a MIME check in finalizeUpload after headObject returns.
